name: whynot-cut
description: AI post-production for Arabic/English vertical reels and podcasts: raw footage to a native Premiere Pro project, podcast reel plans and publish copy, motion videos in After Effects, evidence-based QC. macOS and Windows.

clients_root.title: Client folders location
clients_root.description: Folder that contains your client folders (each with assets/ and data/), e.g. D:\WhyNot Clients or ~/Documents/WhyNot Clients. /whynot-cut:start can set this up for you.

engine_home.title: Engine data folder
engine_home.description: Where the Python environment, Whisper models (~3 GB) and the Premiere job queue live. Leave empty for ~/.whynot-cut (an existing ~/.reel-editor install is reused).
